entries.arabicText: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ
entries.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lah
entries.translation: We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah. Praise is to Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, with no partner.

entries.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
entries.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykan-nushur
entries.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning, by You we enter the evening, by You we live, by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.

entries.arabicText: آيَةُ الْكُرْسِيِّ: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ...
entries.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal hayyul qayyum...
entries.translation: Ayat al-Kursi (Al-Baqarah 2:255) — whoever recites it in the morning is protected until evening.

entries.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ، قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ، قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
entries.transliteration: Qul huwallahu ahad, Qul a'udhu birabbil falaq, Qul a'udhu birabbin nas
entries.translation: The three Quls (Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas), recited three times each in the morning.

entries.arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
entries.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih
entries.translation: Glory be to Allah and praise Him.

entries.arabicText: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
entries.transliteration: Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh
entries.translation: I seek Allah's forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance.

entries.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
entries.transliteration: Allahumma 'afini fi badani, Allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, Allahumma 'afini fi basari, la ilaha illa ant
entries.translation: O Allah, grant my body health, grant my hearing health, grant my sight health. None has the right to be worshipped except You.

entries.arabicText: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ
entries.transliteration: Amsayna wa amsal mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lah
entries.translation: We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah. Praise is to Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, with no partner.

entries.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
entries.transliteration: Allahumma bika amsayna, wa bika asbahna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykal-masir
entries.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the evening, by You we enter the morning, by You we live, by You we die, and to You is the return.

entries.arabicText: آيَةُ الْكُرْسِيِّ: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ...
entries.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal hayyul qayyum...
entries.translation: Ayat al-Kursi (Al-Baqarah 2:255) — whoever recites it in the evening is protected until morning.

entries.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ، قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ، قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
entries.transliteration: Qul huwallahu ahad, Qul a'udhu birabbil falaq, Qul a'udhu birabbin nas
entries.translation: The three Quls (Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas), recited three times each in the evening.

entries.arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
entries.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih
entries.translation: Glory be to Allah and praise Him.

entries.arabicText: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
entries.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
entries.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

entries.arabicText: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ (×3) اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
entries.transliteration: Astaghfirullah (x3), Allahumma antas-salamu wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram
entries.translation: I seek Allah's forgiveness (x3). O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace, blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honor.

entries.arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (×33)، ثُمَّ تَمَامُ الْمِائَةِ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ
entries.transliteration: Subhanallah, walhamdulillah, wallahu akbar (x33 each), then: la ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lah
entries.translation: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, Allah is greatest (33 times each), then: none has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone.

entries.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
entries.transliteration: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatik
entries.translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You in the best of manners.

entries.arabicText: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
entries.transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya
entries.translation: In Your name O Allah, I die and I live.

entries.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
entries.transliteration: Allahumma qini 'adhabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibadak
entries.translation: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day You resurrect Your servants.

entries.arabicText: آيَةُ الْكُرْسِيِّ قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ لِلْحِفْظِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ
entries.transliteration: Ayat al-Kursi before sleep
entries.translation: Reciting Ayat al-Kursi before sleep keeps a protector from Allah near you until morning.

entries.arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
entries.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur
entries.translation: Praise be to Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us, and to Him is the resurrection.
